clue.text: Desert bug

definitions.meaning: to desert is to abandon your side and go over to the enemy
a bug is a fault or flaw, as in a machine or program

explanation.surface: Desert bug: some insect living in the sand.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: the verb meaning to abandon one's side, and the noun for a flaw or imperfection.

clue.text: Tyrant concise dictionary and register of names turned up

parts.note: dict is the short form of dictionary

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a rota is a list of names on duty

explanation.surface: A despot's dictionary and list of names are found.
explanation.definitionFit: An absolute ruler with unchecked power is a despot or tyrant.

clue.text: Envisage opponent capturing rook with check

indicators.note: capturing means the opponent word holds the rook letter

parts.note: a foe is an opponent
R is the chess abbreviation for rook
to see is to check, as in see that the door is locked

explanation.surface: A chess player imagines an opponent taking a rook and giving check.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess surface makes 'check' look like a move, but it means to see.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something before it happens is to anticipate or predict it.

clue.text: She made predictions treated as canards

indicators.note: treated means processed or worked on, so the letters of as canards are reworked

explanation.surface: A seer whose forecasts were dismissed as false rumours.
explanation.walkthrough: A canard is a false rumour, which neatly echoes how her prophecies were received.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan prophetess of Greek myth was fated always to be disbelieved.

clue.text: Careless fielders who'd dropped opener

parts.note: the slips are the close catchers beside the wicketkeeper in cricket

indicators.note: the first letter of the word who'd is let fall, as a catch might be

explanation.surface: A captain grumbles that the fielders were sloppy when they let a catch off the opening batsman go down.
explanation.walkthrough: SLIPS are cricket fielders standing beside the wicketkeeper; 'opener' sounds like the batsman but means the word's first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipshod is a straightforward synonym for sloppy or negligent work.

clue.text: TV detective with a Rolls-Royce in his part of Scotland

parts.note: Lewis is the Oxford detective of the ITV series of that name
and means with

indicators.note: in places a and the car letters inside the word his

explanation.surface: A television detective driving his Rolls-Royce around his home region of Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: Lewis was a British TV detective series set in Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the largest island of the Outer Hebrides, its two parts known by these names.

clue.text: Roger in gym before start of rugger game

indicators.note: in puts the agreement word inside the gym letters

parts.note: PE, physical education, is gym class
roger in radio talk means message received, OK

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of rugger

explanation.surface: A school timetable: gym lesson before the rugby game.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugger is British slang for rugby union.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the card game of betting and bluffing.

clue.text: Musician, bit of a laugh, right superior good man

indicators.note: in a down clue superior means placed above, so the right letter sits over what follows

parts.note: ha is one part of a laugh like ha-ha
pi is short for pious, good
St, short for saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: A musician, a bit of a joker, regarded as a good and superior man.
explanation.definitionFit: This instrumentalist plays the harp, so is a musician.

clue.text: Merchant, one who can give you a hand

definitions.meaning: a trader in goods, as in an antiques trader

definitions.text: one who can give you a hand
definitions.meaning: at cards, the player who hands out the cards gives each player a hand

explanation.surface: A tradesman who is always ready to help.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader in goods and the card player who distributes hands share this name.

clue.text: Infantryman relaxed reading rude rag

indicators.note: relaxed means loosened, so the letters of reading rude rag are loosened and rearranged

explanation.surface: A soldier unwinding with a vulgar newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grenadier Guards are a British Army infantry regiment; a rag is a low-grade newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier in the senior British Army foot guards regiment is an infantryman.

clue.text: Twist Irish county's team

parts.note: Cork is a county in the south of Ireland, with the possessive giving the S
a crew is a team, as of rowers

explanation.surface: A sports report about a twist in fortune for a team from County Cork.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiral, as in a curl of hair, is called by this name, so it works as a noun for a twist.

clue.text: Concept that could make one more relaxed, we hear

indicators.note: says the word for more relaxed is to be heard as spoken, not spelt

parts.note: more relaxed means calmer

explanation.surface: An idea that might help someone unwind.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent the word for 'more relaxed' sounds just like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the Hindu and Buddhist idea of deeds bringing their due consequences, a notion or concept.

clue.text: Refuse to put a cross in a black spot

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
a stain is a spot or mark

explanation.surface: Someone declines to mark a cross on a dark blemish.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross is the one marked on a ballot paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Declining to mark any ballot choice is the act of withholding one's vote.

clue.text: Ace perhaps in one of the Armed Forces

definitions.meaning: in tennis an ace is an unreturned serve, an example of a serve
the army, navy and air force are each called a branch of the forces

explanation.surface: A top pilot serving in the military.
explanation.definitionFit: An ace is one kind of serve in tennis, and each branch of the military is called by this word too.

clue.text: Nymph in folklore, a dryad

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the words that follow, running across their ends

explanation.surface: A tale about a wood nymph from mythology.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this is a mountain nymph, a cousin of the tree-dwelling dryad.

clue.text: A high explosive, and yet I'm being reckless

indicators.note: reckless behaviour throws things about, so the letters of and yet I'm are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone admits to wild behaviour, as dangerous as explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the nitroglycerine-based blasting explosive invented by Nobel.

clue.text: Author of novel 'Kim', at end of Afghan war

indicators.note: novel means new or fresh, so these letters take on a new arrangement
end of means the last letter of Afghan

explanation.surface: An author of the novel Kim, set at the close of the Afghan war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' suggests Kipling's book Kim, but it is the anagram signal; the novelist here is American.
explanation.definitionFit: Samuel Clemens, under this pen name, wrote Huckleberry Finn and Tom Sawyer.

clue.text: Island official putting off chap with desire to roll up

indicators.note: putting off means removing the chap word from the official

parts.note: an alderman is a council official
a man is a chap

indicators.note: in a down clue, to roll up means the word reads upwards

parts.note: a yen is a desire or longing

explanation.surface: An island official sends a man packing who wants to turn up.
explanation.walkthrough: Alderney is one of the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the Channel Islands, a British Crown dependency near France.

clue.text: Other than Ezra, in this biblical location

indicators.note: other indicates a different arrangement of the letters of than and Ezra

explanation.surface: A puzzle about which biblical place is meant, besides Ezra.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Other than' reads as 'except', but 'Other' is the anagram signal and 'than' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the town in Galilee where, according to the Gospels, Jesus grew up.

clue.text: Henceforth, woo fans abroad

indicators.note: abroad means scattered widely, so the letters of woo fans are scattered

explanation.surface: From now on, a celebrity will court admirers overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase marks the present as a starting point, like from now onward.

clue.text: Composer left after party

indicators.note: after places the letter for left following the party word

parts.note: a rave is a large lively party

explanation.surface: A musician who slipped away once the party was over.
explanation.definitionFit: Maurice Ravel was the French composer of Boléro.

clue.text: Decision made by court after composer appears

indicators.note: after puts the court letters following the composer

parts.note: Giuseppe Verdi was the Italian opera composer

explanation.surface: A judgement handed down once a composer turns up in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A jury's finding at the end of a trial is the formal decision.

clue.text: Like fish, mounted

definitions.meaning: covered in scales, as fish are
climbed up, as a wall or a mountain

explanation.surface: A picture of a fish hung on the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish are covered in small plates, and climbing up a rock face is a second meaning.

clue.text: Boasting about Olympic sport

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
rowing is an Olympic sport

explanation.surface: Someone bragging about their Olympic achievements.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to brag loudly, so the -ing form means bragging or boasting.

clue.text: Thoughts of some inside a synagogue

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: What worshippers think while inside a synagogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Notions or concepts arising in the mind are a plain synonym for thoughts.

clue.text: One who's stopped working on Hebridean island

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in business letters
Tiree is an island in the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone who has given up work to live on a Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: TIREE is a small island in the Inner Hebrides, off the west coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who has left employment for good at the end of a career is described this way.

clue.text: Weapon's spike catching knight

indicators.note: catching means the drink word holds the knight letter inside it

parts.note: to lace a drink is to spike it
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A weapon's spiked tip catching a mounted knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spike' looks like a noun, the point of a weapon, but is the verb, as in spiking a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: This long pointed shaft was carried by mounted knights in battle and jousting.

clue.text: Leading character — I'm lying in state: that's life for you!

parts.note: A is the first letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: lying in puts the letters of I'm inside the word for state

parts.note: a nation is a state

explanation.surface: Someone lying in state after death, with a wry comment on life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lying in state' suggests a funeral, but 'lying in' is the container signal and 'state' is NATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Liveliness or vitality is meant, the sense of being full of life and spirit.

clue.text: Losing team's disadvantage

parts.note: a team behind in a match is said to be down
a side is a team

explanation.surface: The drawback faced by a team that keeps losing.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverse aspect or drawback of something is its negative side.

clue.text: Where Diddy Men live, saving remains perplexing

indicators.note: saving means except, so the remains are left out

parts.note: Knotty Ash is the Liverpool district where comedian Ken Dodd's Diddy Men lived
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A puzzling question about where the Diddy Men live.
explanation.walkthrough: Ken Dodd was a British comedian; his tiny Diddy Men came from Knotty Ash, a real Liverpool district. 'saving' means 'except'.
explanation.definitionFit: A problem full of tangles is hard to solve, hence puzzling or complicated.
